stages.title: Fab / cleanroom facility
stages.summary: A semiconductor fabrication plant (fab) is a sealed cleanroom campus with ultra-pure water, specialty gases, vibration control, and tool bays. Different product lines (logic, memory, photonics, power) share the same idea — keep particles out and yield in — but use different wafers, tools, and packaging steps.

companies.name: Samsung C&T
companies.note: Builds Samsung’s own fabs and cleanrooms

stages.title: What we’re making: logic (CPU / GPU / ASIC)
stages.summary: Leading-edge logic chips — host CPUs, merchant GPUs, and custom AI ASICs — are patterned on advanced silicon nodes. Design happens in EDA software (Software section); this schematic is the factory path from blank wafer to packaged die.

companies.name: TSMC
companies.note: Default advanced foundry for AI logic

stages.title: What we’re making: HBM (high-bandwidth memory)
stages.summary: High-bandwidth memory stacks tall DRAM dies and attaches them beside AI logic with advanced packaging. The memory wafers are made in DRAM fabs; the glue step (CoWoS-class and peers) is often the choke — see Hardware scarcity and this section’s packaging layer.

stages.title: What we’re making: photonics / optical components
stages.summary: Optical interconnect parts — lasers, modulators, detectors, and silicon photonics — use compound semiconductors and/or silicon photonics flows plus specialized photomasks and materials. Deep company maps live under Hardware → Photonics; this view is the fab-side workflow.

companies.name: See Hardware / Photonics

companies.name: Photronics / DNP / Hoya

stages.title: What we’re making: SiC / GaN power devices (SST-adjacent)
stages.summary: Silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) power devices switch and convert electricity more efficiently than plain silicon — used in datacenter power stages and in solid-state transformer (SST) style conversion. Industry read (2026): rack-level 800 V DC sidecars begin late 2026 / early 2027; native 800 V racks and SST pilots gather in 2027; facility-wide HVDC / scaled SSTs more 2028–2029. SiC dominates high-voltage rectification and MV SST stages; GaN often wins high-frequency 800 V→low-voltage DC–DC. Full SST system architecture lives under Electrification; this schematic is the device fab.

companies.demand_detail: As 800 V DC racks and SST pilots scale ~2027–2028, SiC MOSFET content per MW rises. ROHM’s SiC/GaN portfolio is less crowded in US AI narratives than ON/STM/IFX, so incremental datacenter demand may still be under-reflected versus peers — orientation only, not advice.

stages.title: Starting wafers
stages.summary: Every chip starts as a polished wafer. Logic and most DRAM use silicon (often 300 mm). SiC and GaN use specialty substrates. Photonics may use indium phosphide or other compound wafers — materials houses feed the fab before lithography begins.

companies.name: Coherent (II-VI)
companies.demand_detail: SiC substrate supply quality remains a gating item for high-voltage device ramps used in AI DC and SST paths.

stages.title: Lithography (pattern printing)
stages.summary: Lithography prints circuit patterns with light. Extreme ultraviolet (EUV) is required for the densest advanced-logic layers; deep ultraviolet (DUV) still does most other layers. Photomasks (reticles) carry the pattern. High-NA EUV is a later (~2028–2029) capability step if leading-edge AI silicon stays hot.

stages.title: Deposition & etch (WFE)
stages.summary: Wafer fabrication equipment deposits thin films and etches them into structures. Atomic layer deposition, chemical vapor deposition, epitaxy, and plasma etch are the workhorses for transistors, interconnects, and memory stacks.

stages.title: Implant, CMP & clean
stages.summary: Ion implantation dopes silicon with precise impurities. Chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) polishes wafers flat between layers. Wet cleans remove residues so the next lithography step can succeed.

stages.title: Inspection & metrology
stages.summary: Process control finds killer defects and measures whether films and critical dimensions landed correctly. Without it, EUV and multi-patterning CapEx is wasted.

stages.title: Consumables — resists, gases, UPW
stages.summary: Photoresists, specialty chemicals, ultrapure gases, and ultrapure water are continuous inputs. They look less glamorous than scanners, but every advanced line depends on them.

stages.title: Advanced packaging (CoWoS / OSAT / EMIB)
stages.summary: After the die is made, advanced packaging connects logic to HBM and other chiplets with short, dense wiring. TSMC’s CoWoS-class flows, OSATs (Amkor, ASE), and Intel’s EMIB-T are the main AI paths. Capacity has been tight into about 2027.

stages.title: HBM stacking & attach
stages.summary: HBM dies are stacked vertically (TSVs and micro-bumps) then attached next to the accelerator on an interposer or bridge. Yield and capacity here couple memory supply to packaging — physical tightness is not the same as a cheap stock.

stages.title: Photomasks & optical materials
stages.summary: Photomasks (reticles) hold the pattern for each lithography layer. EUV masks are especially hard. Optical materials suppliers feed both mask shops and photonics component makers — see also Hardware / Photonics.

stages.title: Silicon photonics / III–V process bays
stages.summary: Silicon photonics integrates optical functions on silicon; many lasers and detectors still need compound-semiconductor (III–V) epitaxy and specialty process tools. Finished optical engines and DSPs are mapped under Hardware / Photonics.

stages.title: SiC / GaN epi & device process
stages.summary: Wide-bandgap power devices grow epitaxial layers on SiC or GaN wafers, then pattern power transistors and diodes. High-end / high-voltage SiC MOSFET capacity (especially automotive- and industrial-qualified) has stayed structurally tight even as lower-end 150 mm substrate chatter turns to oversupply risk. AI datacenter and SST designs need 1,200 V-class SiC for rectification/protection and higher-voltage SiC for MV SST stages — reallocating capacity from EV contracts. Larger wafers (200 mm) and yields are the industrial story through 2026–2028.

stages.title: Wafer & package test
stages.summary: Automatic test equipment proves chips work before they ship. AI parts are large and expensive — bad units hurt more. Probe cards, handlers, and burn-in systems sit at the end of the line.
